result.topic_en: Crystallographic axis ratios of aragonite (after Kupffer) and a ternary quadratic form whose substitution yields a form associated with calcite, with the parameter k determined for calcite.
result.transcription:
Arragonit nach Kupfer

Adiuncta

$1 \quad 0{,}38633 \quad 0{,}51914$ \qquad $1 \quad 2{,}5884 \quad 1{,}9263$
$0 \quad 0 \quad 0$ \qquad $0 \quad 0 \quad 0$
\qquad $0{,}41304 \quad 0{,}28472$

oder
$2{,}5884 \quad 1{,}0000 \quad 1{,}34375$
$0{,}647$ [?]
$1{,}3437$ [?] $1{,}000$ [?]

Seine Zeichnung \quad $M \quad 1{,}1{,}0$
$h \quad 1{,}0{,}0$
$P \quad 1{,}0{,}1$

Die form $\begin{pmatrix}1, & 3, & k\\ 0, & 0, & 0\end{pmatrix}$ geht durch die Substitution

$x = u + u' - 2u''$ \qquad umgekehrt $6u = x + 3y + 2z$
$y = u - u'$ \qquad $6u' = x - 3y + 2z$
$z = u + u' + u''$ \qquad $6u'' = -2x \quad . \quad + 2z$
$x \equiv z \mod 3$
$x \equiv y \mod 2$

über in
$\begin{pmatrix}4+k, & 4+k, & 4+k\\ k-2, & k-2, & k-2\end{pmatrix}$

Um den Kalkspath zu produciren ist $k =$ [-$1{,}02767$-] {+$0{,}973003$+} zu setzen

methods.what: Axis ratios of aragonite crystal (after Kupffer) and adjoint values
Miller-type indices of crystal faces M, h, P
Linear substitution transforming the ternary form (1,3,k;0,0,0) into (4+k,4+k,4+k;k-2,k-2,k-2), with inverse and congruence conditions
Congruence conditions for integrality of the inverse substitution
Value of k giving the calcite form
